sources.description: US Census TIGER state boundaries at 1:10,000,000 scale, packaged as TopoJSON by topojson/us-atlas. Public domain.
Natural Earth country boundaries at 1:10,000,000 scale. ~254 entities including microstates (Malta, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, Andorra). Used for country/region-scale renders.
Natural Earth country boundaries at 1:110,000,000 scale. ~177 entities, microstates omitted. Used for world-scale renders where fast load matters more than detail.
Census Bureau 2023 ZCTA gazetteer — centroid + area for every ZIP Code Tabulation Area. Public domain (US Census).
Census Bureau 2023 Places gazetteer — centroid + area for every incorporated place + CDP. Public domain (US Census).
